title: Write src/greeting.txt
body:
## Goal
Create exactly one file, `src/greeting.txt`, containing the single line `hello from perpetua`. Write nothing else.
## Acceptance
- [ ] `src/greeting.txt` exists and its content is exactly `hello from perpetua` followed by a newline
- [ ] no other file is created or changed
## Verification
`python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(open('src/greeting.txt').read() != 'hello from perpetua\n')"`
## Context
- goal: `.session/loop-state.json` `goal.text` defines the file and its content
## Budget
- `src/greeting.txt` (the only file to write)
